limitations: Accepted for background and medium-distance environment dressing, not hero close-up prop inspection.
The initial family contains only barrel and crate variants; sacks, carts, baskets, pallets and context-specific labels remain future inventory rather than being faked through recolouring.
The barrel does not yet expose individually detachable staves or close-range fasteners, and the crate omits close-range nails, joinery wear and contents.

Placement currently targets an explicit flat ground plane. Sloped or irregular terrain requires a future surface-query and normal-alignment contract rather than the unused slope limit rejected during this iteration.
